title: Butterflies in $\textrm{T}\overline{\textrm{T}}$ deformed anomalous CFT$_2$
summary: We study quantum chaos in $\textrm{T}\overline{\textrm{T}}$-deformed two-dimensional conformal field theories with gravitational anomaly and their holographic dual description in topologically massive gravity. Using pole-skipping and shock-wave analysis, we extract the Lyapunov exponent and butterfly velocity and analyze the interplay between irrelevant deformation and parity-violating dynamics.
